title: City of Tulsa/ Tulsa County Emergency Operations Plan - City of Tulsa, United States of America
landscapes: Athletics, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Urban
description: This plan has been developed to provide a comprehensive (multi-use) emergency management program for Tulsa County.  It seeks to mitigate the effects of hazards, prepare for measures to be taken which will preserve life and minimize damage and prevent incidents from occurring through a focus on deterrence operations and surveillance systems. Additionally, this plan should enhance response during emergencies, provide necessary assistance, and establish a recovery system in order to return the county and the cities/towns to their normal state of affairs.
